$description: Direction C, 'Mérőlap': the synthesis Claude Design proposed (design/claude-design, 2026-10-08). The calm, image-led structure of B with the measuring language of A: near-black, off-white type, the brand pink on the main button and as light on the hero sign only, measuring-tape yellow for measurements, a characterful grotesque in sentence case. Overrides stilet.tokens.json; selected with SITE_THEME=merolap.

$extensions.hu.stiletdekor.note: Claude Design draws the titles at line-height 0.96; here leading.tight stays at 1.0 so the accents of Hungarian capitals (Ő, Ű, Á) never touch the line above.

measure.$description: Measuring-tape yellow: dimension lines, rulers, focus of measurements.

brand-glow.$value: 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklab, {color.brand} 55%, transparent), 0 0 22px -4px color-mix(in oklab, {color.brand} 75%, transparent)
